banner.title: SIRCOF COFFEE
banner.subtitle: Artisanal coffee from the mountains of Costa Rica

section01.title: A Family Business
section01.description: Café Sircof is a Costa Rican family business with over 20 years of tradition and passion for coffee. Born in the heart of Costa Rica's mountains, our company is primarily driven by my father, who alongside the family dedicates his life to every detail of our process.

section02.title: Artisanal Process
section02.description: We control the entire production process: from hand-picking the beans to the final packaging. Every step is carried out with dedication to ensure a superior quality product.

section03.title: Global & Local
section03.description: Our coffee is present in the main markets of Costa Rica and transcends borders: we export to the United States and China, bringing the quality and tradition of Café Sircof to high-value international markets.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: We are a family-owned coffee-growing business dedicated to satisfying the tastes and needs of coffee lovers with an excellent quality product that exceeds our customers' expectations.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To offer an excellent product to the end consumer—both domestic and international—by producing, processing, and manufacturing our 100% pure high-altitude coffee with transparency, without intermediaries, and at a fair price.

tradition.title: Responsibility
tradition.description: We deliver on our promises, caring for every stage of the process, from the crop to your cup.

quality.title: Punctuality
quality.description: We respect your time: we harvest, process, and deliver every order right when we said we would.

sustainability.title: Solidarity
sustainability.description: We grow alongside our community, supporting the families and farmers who make our coffee possible.

passion.title: Family unity, traceability, and honesty
passion.description: We are a family working together, offering coffee of known origin and full transparency in everything we do.

contact.title: Would you like to try our coffee?
